Name: Interiors of Pelican Town - Starter Farmhouse and 1st Upgrade
Author: QueenAcademe
Description:
[b]Description ﻿
[/b]﻿
Redesign of the starter farmhouse and first upgrade to include a kitchen and bathroom. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to switch the beams between Vanilla, Rustic Country Town Interior (Dark) and Rustic Country Town Interior (White). You can also toggle each map on/off to mix and match with other farmhouse interiors.

[b]Known Bugs [/b]
You will initially spawn in a bed embedded in the wall. Just navigate out and re-place the bed where desired. The interior windows are also lit at all times of the day/weather. This may be fixed in future updates.
